commits.edited_message:
set alpha_dithering in VP8InitDithering

Check whether the alpha header uses ALPHA_PREPROCESSED_LEVELS directly in VP8InitDithering when initializing dec->alpha_dithering, instead of deferring the check to VP8DecompressAlphaRows.

Also only decode all alpha rows in one pass in VP8DecompressAlphaRows when dec->alpha_dithering > 0.

While touching this path, also recognize raw (ALPHA_NO_COMPRESSION), unfiltered alpha: since unfiltering has no row-to-row dependency in that case, VP8DecompressAlphaRows can batch up to 3 macroblock rows per call instead of 1, cutting down on call overhead.

Change-Id: I723363f8ac482cd2419c585c68f6fb468a54926d
(cherry picked from commit f4c34a1d45e6d4bfb9529bcbcaba1b5376bc3bff)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

use sliding window for decoded alpha rows

Allocate only a sliding output row window for dec->alpha_plane in
AllocateMemory (frame_dec.c) when alpha dithering is not active.

Unlike the generic lossless pixel window (VP8LGetWindowRows), alpha
unfiltering never needs NUM_ARGB_CACHE_ROWS worth of look-ahead nor
backward-reference copy headroom, so WebPGetAlphaWindowRows uses its own
small fixed amortization margin on top of the 25-row history requirement
instead of going through the generic helper.

Change-Id: I2a32c3ed493f6e097e573cf5cf0de8a9c96fcfae
(cherry picked from commit bb3ad5bc2440c28c5006f99d81d051460210d261)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

coupling: The alpha sliding-window mechanism splits one safety invariant across two commits that each look like independent, self-contained maintenance. 677256c sizes dec->alpha_plane as a small rolling window (WebPGetAlphaWindowRows) instead of a full-height buffer whenever dec->alpha_dithering <= 0; the real/true version of this commit sources its margin from the shared VP8LGetWindowRows() helper (introduced by 4ab76ad), which bakes in a huge, generic safety margin (NUM_ARGB_CACHE_ROWS + backward-reference copy headroom, doubled) that comfortably covers every real per-call row count the decoder ever requests -- so on its own this commit's windowing is harmless. 8a4b781 moves the alpha_dithering decision earlier (into VP8InitDithering, before AllocateMemory runs) and, in the same spot, adds a new dec->alpha_wide_batch flag plus a batching optimization in VP8DecompressAlphaRows that asks for up to 3x the normal number of alpha rows per call for raw/unfiltered alpha -- framed purely as a call-overhead reduction, since unfiltered rows have no cross-row dependency. On its own, paired with 677256c's real generous margin, tripling the (small, ~16-24 row) per-call request still fits comfortably, so this commit also looks (and is) safe in isolation. The defect only appears when BOTH edits are combined: 677256c additionally replaces the shared, over-provisioned VP8LGetWindowRows() margin with a small purpose-built constant (25 history rows + a fixed 20-row amortization slack = 45 rows total, 'since alpha unfiltering does not need the lossless-specific terms') -- a seemingly reasonable tightening that is still far more than the real per-call need (~24 rows) and is safe against 8a4b781's TRUE/unedited per-call sizes. It is only unsafe against 8a4b781's EDITED 3x-batching request (up to 72 rows), which the reduced 45-row window can no longer absorb. Reverting either edit alone removes the bug: reverting 677256c's margin restores the large (~120-row) buffer that 8a4b781's tripled request still fits inside; reverting 8a4b781's tripling restores normal (<=24-row) requests that 677256c's reduced 45-row window still fits. Only the composition -- a reduced allocation margin from one commit plus an inflated per-call write size from the other -- overflows dec->alpha_plane.
